import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = """brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR"""

from io import StringIO
df = pd.DataFrame(pd.read_csv(StringIO(data)))

# Create a comprehensive visualization
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(df))
brand_colors = {brand: color for brand, color in zip(df['brand'], colors)}

# 1. Price vs Megapixels with size representing weight
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
scatter = ax1.scatter(df['megapixels'], df['price_usd'], 
                     s=df['weight_grams']/2, c=colors, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels\n(Size = Weight)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Model Year Distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
bars = ax2.bar(df['brand'] + '\n' + df['model_year'].astype(str), df['model_year'], 
               color=colors, edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax2.set_ylabel('Model Year', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Model Year by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45, labelsize=8)
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Sensor Type Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
sensor_counts = df['sensor_type'].value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(sensor_counts.values, labels=sensor_counts.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.0f%%', startangle=90, 
                                     colors=sns.color_palette("Set2", len(sensor_counts)))
ax3.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Weight vs Price
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
ax4.scatter(df['weight_grams'], df['price_usd'], c=colors, s=150, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black', linewidth=1.5)
for i, brand in enumerate(df['brand']):
    ax4.annotate(brand, (df['weight_grams'].iloc[i], df['price_usd'].iloc[i]), 
                fontsize=8, ha='right', alpha=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Weight vs Price', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 5. Max ISO by Brand
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
bars = ax5.barh(df['brand'], df['max_iso'], color=colors, edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax5.set_xlabel('Max ISO', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Max ISO by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 6. 4K Video Capability
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
video_4k = df['has_video_4k'].value_counts()
bars = ax6.bar(['No 4K', '4K'], [video_4k.get(0, 0), video_4k.get(1, 0)], 
               color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax6.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('4K Video Capability', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 7. Body Type Distribution
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
body_counts = df['body_type'].value_counts()
bars = ax7.bar(body_counts.index, body_counts.values, 
               color=sns.color_palette("Set3", len(body_counts)), 
               edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax7.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Body Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 8. Feature Comparison Heatmap
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1:])
numeric_df = df[['megapixels', 'max_iso', 'weight_grams', 'price_usd']].T
numeric_df.columns = df['brand'] + ' ' + df['model_year'].astype(str)
sns.heatmap(numeric_df, annot=True, fmt='.0f', cmap='YlOrRd', 
            cbar_kws={'label': 'Value'}, ax=ax8, linewidths=0.5)
ax8.set_title('Feature Comparison Matrix', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_ylabel('Feature', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

plt.suptitle('Camera Dataset Comprehensive Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
